notes.title: First Update - EX and More!
notes.content:
Hey everybody,



The first major update for Touhou Picross is out!



The main attraction is the EX stage, continuing the story and challenging players with ten new puzzles.



I've also added the following:

Puzzle completion statistics on the save file selection screen

A music room with my comments on each track

Five new standalone puzzles



I hope you all enjoy the new content!

notes.title: Update Notes for August 5, 2024
notes.content:
